apply_order_note: Each patch is a git diff against base_commit and touches its own lines, so any subset applies in this order. 06 and 07 both change cron/scheduler.py in different places.

patches.purpose: Adds an opt-in delivery gate (cron.deliver_gate) and a pre_deliver plugin hook so scheduled results and send_message messages can be held whole until a time the profile's plugin names.
Gives every background-helper result its own delivery identity on strict (durable) transports, so the second and later results in a chat are not refused as duplicates.
zeus_features: background helper results reach the chat

patches.purpose: Stops the watchdog from flagging a brand-new turn as a closed ghost before its session row is written.
Makes the 'still working on your last message' busy note a per-profile display setting (display.busy_ack_enabled) instead of one gateway-wide environment variable.
Lets the agent stay silent on a bare 'ok' / 'thanks' / thumbs-up without the gateway sending an unexpected-silence warning, and makes that warning plain-spoken.
zeus_features: no reply needed to a bare acknowledgement

patches.purpose: Per-profile reasoning effort: cron.reasoning_effort for scheduled jobs, a separate effort for background review, and the profile-owned Grok 4.7 effort opt-in honored by cron and delegated work.
Opt-in agent.work_model_tiers: routes a turn, scheduled job or delegated task to a configured lookup / workflow / recovery model by what the instruction asks for.
zeus_features: optional model tiers (not used by the default Zeus config)

patches.purpose: Photon iMessage: tapbacks that mean something (reactions: meaning), link preview bubbles (link_bubbles), optional status stickers, a per-recipient tapback opt-out, and an in-place refresh of a quiet inbound stream instead of a sidecar restart.
